title: She became the first Indian-origin, first woman of color to lead a 131-office global ad network.
sources: Forbes India - Devika Bulchandani named first Indian-origin global CEO of Ogilvy
GlobalIndian.com - Devika Bulchandani, first woman of colour to head Ogilvy, career background
caption:
She became the first Indian-origin, first woman of color to lead a 131-office global ad network.

After 26 years at McCann, Bulchandani was named Global CEO of Ogilvy in September 2022 - the storied British-founded advertising network with offices in 93 countries.

Ogilvy's global network spans 131 offices worldwide. Bulchandani's appointment made her both the first Indian-origin CEO and the first woman of color to hold the role in the agency's history.

Indian-origin leadership at the top of global business used to cluster in tech and finance. Advertising, media and culture-facing industries are now part of the same story - each new first widens where the next one can happen.
